subject: SF Edge Summit — on-call float & last-mile transport plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SF Edge Summit — on-call float & last-mile transport plan

Team —

We need a concise last-mile and on-call float plan for SF Edge Summit (July 27–29). Main concerns: vendor drop windows at the Marina Center, late arrivals from OAK/SFO runs, and staffing gaps between booth teardown shifts (2300–0200). Proposal below — please review and flag gaps: 

- On-call float: 2 drivers per evening shift (1800–0200) as backups to handle late arrivals and run last-mile shuttle.
- Primary pickup point: Loading Dock B (see attached map) — coordinate with Marina Center ops.
- Hotel staging: reserve 2 rooms for on-call drivers at Hotel Meridian with late check-in until 01:00.
- Manifest: initial driver list attached (driver_manifest.csv). Add driver mobile numbers and plate numbers.
- Vendor coordination: Ally Rios (EventTemps) as local float backup + CityShuttle hold for two vehicles on standby.

Action items: 
- Marissa: confirm driver names and contact numbers by EOD today.
- Laura: reach out to Marina ops to confirm Dock B access and evening gate code.
- Vanessa: place the temporary hotel block and share confirmation; include early-arrival options.

We should avoid last-minute taxi reimbursements where possible — prefer contracted standby vehicles.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Field Events
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: SF Edge Summit — on-call float & last-mile transport plan

Markus —

Thanks for the outline. I'm pulling names now. Quick notes: 
- I can guarantee 3 trained drivers from our pool on Thursday/Friday nights; I'll add them to the manifest and include mobile numbers.
- Ally (eventtemps) can supply one rapid-replacement driver on call for Saturday night if needed (she's local).
- One ask: can we push the vendor drop window earlier by 15 minutes (1830 start) to reduce overlap with rush hour? Marina ops may push back but worth asking.

Attaching the initial manifest (same file name) with placeholder numbers — will update by 16:00.

Marissa
Senior Field Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SF Edge Summit — standby vehicle availability and quote

Hi Markus / Marissa —

CityShuttle can allocate two 12-passenger vans on standby for the evenings of July 26–29 (we recommend coverage the night before for early setups). Summary: 

- Vehicles: 2 x 12p vans on standby (on-site hold at Loading Dock B)
- On-call window: 18:30–02:30 (per request; we can extend to 03:00 on high-traffic nights)
- Rate: $55/hr per vehicle, minimum 4 hours per night; overtime billed at 1.5x after 4 hours.
- Driver rest: drivers rotate after 6 hours; replacement drivers available on-site for $25/hour.

We require formal confirmation to hold the vehicles and will send an invoice for the first night's retainer ($440). Attached: proposed quote and standard terms (cityshuttle_quote.pdf).

Please confirm pickup point is Loading Dock B and whether Marina will allow vehicles to stage there after 22:00.

Regards,
Sophie L.
Ops Manager — CityShuttle Logistics
ops@cityshuttle.com
